flags.why: Dỏm is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label.
The example explains what an infinitive is instead of showing the term applied in context.
flags.fix: Giáo viên yêu cầu chúng tôi tìm các động từ ở dạng vô định trong đoạn văn. = The teacher asked us to find the verbs in the infinitive form in the passage.

flags.why: Thất lễ remains current in courteous apologies and should not be labelled dated.
The learner is more likely to encounter the ordinary [scabies sense](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gh%E1%BA%BB) than the restricted step-parent sense.

Giải trình belongs to formal administrative usage, as illustrated by its use in [official explanations](https://pbgdpl.gov.vn/Pages/nghien-cuu-trao-doi.aspx?ItemID=2660&l=Nghiencuutraodoi), and needs a formal label.
